facts.claim: Median free-to-paid conversion across all products is 8%, while freemium models sit closer to 2% to 5%
facts.excerpt: The median free-to-paid conversion rate across all products is 8%. Freemium models sit closer to 2-5%.

facts.claim: The median app retains 4% of its users at day 30, and 25.3% return on day one
facts.source_title: Mobile App Retention Benchmarks by Industry 2026
facts.excerpt: The median app retains just 4% of users at Day 30. Only 25.3% of mobile app users return on Day 1.

facts.claim: Hard paywalls reach a 10.7% median day-35 download-to-paid conversion against 2.1% for freemium
facts.excerpt: median of 10.7% for apps with hard paywalls versus 2.1% in freemium apps for Day 35 download-to-paid

facts.claim: Across 80+ SaaS products, freemium-to-paid averaged 3.7%, ranging from 2.6% in ed-tech to 5.8% in reg-tech
facts.excerpt: An average freemium-to-paid conversion rate of 3.7% for traditional freemium, with industry variation from 2.6% in EdTech to 5.8% in RegTech.

facts.claim: Price localisation wins 62.3% of experiments, the highest win rate of any test type
facts.excerpt: Localization tests win 62.3% of the time in experiments, the highest win rate of any test type

facts.claim: Cost per install in India runs about 0.12 times the United States level, 70% to 90% lower
facts.source_title: Cost per install benchmarks by country, platform and category
facts.excerpt: India has a CPI of 0.12x relative to the United States. CPIs in India are often 70-90% lower than US CPIs.
